title: Known K1/K2 layer (ABSCISSA, PALIMPSEST, PALIMPCEST, KRYPTOS on the KRYPTOS or A-Z tableau, every phase, both directions, before or after) plus the full key-rule battery on a second keyword tableau
k4_result: Main run: 0 of 8,705,296 alphabet-variant pairs pass with 7+ checks (chance predicts 0.29). Part 1: 280 variants x 19,622 alphabets (A-Z, KRYPTOS, theme words, common words). Part 2: the 16 phase-0 KRYPTOS-tableau variants x 200,696 more plain dictionary keyword alphabets. Follow-up run: the same 16 variants on the 446,675 transposition-mixed dictionary alphabets, 7,146,800 pairs. 3 pass with exactly 7 checks (chance 0.24), all one coincidence: one alphabet (DULLARDNESS~keyed, M/M Vigenere), one variant (PALIMPSEST deciphering, phase 0, known layer last), two stacked keys p=5 with q=14, 21, 42 (nested lengths). Readings are gibberish: big model -8.25 (English needs -5.1), the q=42 one too short to read. Nothing at 8+ checks anywhere.
controls: 3 shuffled K4s, all 280 variants, each on a different 1/9 slice of the alphabets. Main run: 967,480 / 967,480 / 967,200 pairs, 0 / 0 / 0 pass (chance 0.03 each). Follow-up: 794,096 pairs each, 0 / 0 / 0 pass (chance 0.03 each). K4's single 7-check coincidence in 15.9M pairs is in line with chance (0.53 expected in all) and does not read.
planted: 3/3 (ABSCISSA on KRYPTOS at phase 3, known layer first, then a sliding key of 5 on dictionary tableau TANTALIZE; progressive key p=7 on PRIVANT (Beaufort), then PALIMPSEST at phase 4, known layer last; ABSCISSA deciphering on A-Z at phase 5, then plain autokey lag 2 on ATTITUDINIZER). Each searched over all 280 variants x 303 alphabets: only the true variant and alphabet passed (sister rules of the same key, e.g. sliding p=7 for progressive p=7, give the same reading or '?'), read back 97/97, English -4.27 to -4.47.
scope_limits: Known-layer keys: only ABSCISSA, PALIMPSEST, PALIMPCEST and KRYPTOS, Vigenere-type add or subtract (no Beaufort known layer), on the KRYPTOS or A-Z tableau. Variants with the key not starting at K4 letter 1 (264 of 280) were run only on A-Z, KRYPTOS, 84 theme alphabets and 19.5k common-word keyword alphabets, not on the full 666,993. The A-Z-tableau phase-0 variants were also run only on the small set. Layer two: one keyword tableau (plain or transposition-mixed dictionary alphabet), five layouts, Vigenere/Beaufort, the round-11 battery (repeating 1-17, sliding 1-15, progressive 1-12, autokey lags 1-6 on M, chain addition) plus idea-104 fixes (every stacked pair exactly on the 24 letters, autokey fed letter numbered on A-Z/KRYPTOS, progressive moved on in another order). Not covered: idea 104's gap-slack, mod 27-31, multiplier, one-letter-dropped and word-break variants; hidden alphabets; running keys; transposition between or around the layers; a third layer; controls ran on 1/9 slices, not 1/3.

negative.family: known K1/K2 layer plus second tableau
negative.hypothesis: K4 was put through the K1/K2 machine (ABSCISSA/PALIMPSEST/PALIMPCEST/KRYPTOS on the KRYPTOS or A-Z tableau) before or after a second keyword tableau with a repeating, sliding, progressive, autokey, chain or two-stacked-word key.
negative.scope: 280 known-layer variants (2 tableaux x 4 key words x every phase x add/subtract x before/after) on A-Z, KRYPTOS, 84 theme and 19.5k common-word keyword alphabets; the 16 phase-0 KRYPTOS variants on all 666,993 dictionary alphabets (plain and transposition-mixed); layer two through the round-11 battery plus idea-104 fixes, 5 layouts, Vig/Beau, 7+ exact checks; 15.85M alphabet-variant pairs.
negative.outcome: Dead: 0 passes in the main run (8.7M pairs, chance 0.29); 3 at exactly 7 checks in the mixed-alphabet run (7.1M pairs, chance 0.24), one coincidence (DULLARDNESS~keyed, PALIMPSEST dec, stacked p=5 q=14/21/42) reading -8.25. Nothing at 8+ (controls: 3 shuffled K4s on 1/9 slices, 0 passes in all six runs; planted 3/3 found as the only reading and read back 97/97).

follow_ups: Run the 264 off-phase variants on all 666,993 alphabets (about 2 hours of slot time at 2.3 ms per pair), or argue a phase from the K2/K3 lengths and run only that phase.

Known K1/K2 layer plus a hidden layer-two alphabet: the transformed clue pairs can go straight into the idea-93 linear systems (rules linear in the alphabet positions), which take any 24 letter pairs.
